scope: Independent read-only first-checkpoint audit; no solver campaigns.

method.positionMetric: Euclidean distance between equal-ID xyz at identical binary saved times; no interpolation.
method.replayLayout: Float64LE: time, then per drone [x,y,z,qx,qy,qz,qw]. Quaternion is xyzw.
method.quantile: Nearest rank ceil(p*n), except median uses statistics.median.
method.postHoc: All new ensemble, finish-time, and normalized diagnostics are descriptive; they do not replace the frozen 1 cm test.

historicalSourcePreservationRecheck.scope: Checked declared sanitized historical source records only; prior 793-pass audit is preserved history, not a fresh public byte-equality result.

method.contact: Replay only the affected independent rigid body from its recorded preceding-control state, with its frozen command, for two primary steps; check all boxes from the trial-specific saved geometry.
method.order: Re-evaluate one preserved 20 s full-state checkpoint per 1000-drone geometry. Reverse neighbor IDs while holding every state, route, geometry, gain, and filter fixed; compare requested velocities. This reverses both floating-point social summation order and sequential pair projection order, so it does not isolate them. This is a post-hoc controller sensitivity probe, not a mission or an accepted variant.
method.scope: Per invocation: six RK4 integration steps; no full swarm simulation. Reusing frozen functions tests consistency and local sensitivity, not independent physical correctness.
method.exactOrderOperation: For every drone i=0..999, forward IDs are Grid.neighbors(i, 1.8), sorted ascending by frozen Grid.candidates; reverse IDs are ids.slice().reverse(). Both full ID lists and per-drone output residuals are retained.
method.inferenceLimit: Neighbor reversal is a new exploratory same-state calculation. It is not preregistered confirmation, not improved accuracy, and not an identified cause of the saved timestep divergence.
